en: <color=#FFFFBF>Sinthia:</color> You're sure this is the address Sally wrote down...?
<color=#FFFFBF>Sym:</color> She wrote something on the back, too.
<color=#FFFFBF>Sinthia:</color> Oh yeah, what was that – instructions?
<color=#FFFFBF>Sym:</color> ...it's a little poem. You should read it.
Mariana Moon, avoiding all questions about where she was headed, simply disappeared over the horizon.
Madam Tadpole became captain of the Mortuga Submarine. Dr Zephyr stayed on board to continue his research - newly inspired by what he'd witnessed.
Wirman announced he wasn't going to write the sequel to his novel. Dirk was subsequently released from his contract with Wit & Whimsy.
